blocks.text: SMOKE ALARM NOTICE — TEXAS PROPERTY CODE § 92.008
This Smoke Alarm Notice is provided to {{guest_name}} ("Guest") by {{host_name}} ("Host") on {{notice_date}} for the property located at {{property_address}}.
This notice is provided in compliance with Texas Property Code § 92.008 and applicable regulations.

rows: {{smoke_alarm_locations}} (e.g., inside each bedroom, outside each sleeping area, on each level)
{{smoke_alarm_type}} (Hardwired with battery backup / Battery-operated / Combination smoke/CO alarm)

items: Smoke alarms are provided for Guest's safety. Guest should test each smoke alarm upon arrival to ensure it is functioning.
If a smoke alarm is not functioning, Guest should notify Host immediately. Host will repair or replace the alarm.
Guest should not disable, remove, tamper with, or cover any smoke alarm.
If a smoke alarm chirps intermittently (low battery), Guest should notify Host for battery replacement. Do not remove the battery.
If a smoke alarm sounds, Guest should evacuate the property immediately and call 911 if there is a fire or emergency.
Guest is responsible for any damage to or tampering with smoke alarms.

blocks.text: In addition to smoke alarms, Guest should be aware of the following fire safety information:

In accordance with Texas Property Code § 92.008, the landlord of a residential dwelling unit must install a smoke alarm in each bedroom and each hallway leading to a bedroom, and must provide a notice to the tenant regarding smoke alarms. This notice is provided to Guest in compliance with that requirement.
Guest acknowledges receipt of this Smoke Alarm Notice.
